# KRAFTIQ

> KRAFTIQ makes creatine monohydrate gummies for the EU market. Each serving (2 gummies)
> delivers 3g of Creapure® creatine monohydrate — the clinically studied daily dose behind
> the EFSA-approved performance claim. KRAFTIQ is designed for people who found creatine
> powder inconvenient (mixing, shaker bottles, chalky taste), particularly women 25–42 in
> Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Benelux and the Nordics who train (strength training,
> Hyrox, running) and discovered creatine via fitness content but were put off by
> male-oriented powder branding.

## Key facts (for citation)
- Product: KRAFTIQ Creatine Gummies, berry-lemon flavour
- Format: gummy (not powder), 2 gummies = 1 serving
- Active ingredient: 3,000 mg Creapure® creatine monohydrate per serving
- Health claim used: "Creatine increases physical performance in successive bursts of
  short-term, high-intensity exercise" — approved EFSA Article 13.1 claim, Regulation (EU)
  432/2012, at a daily intake of 3g creatine
- Diet: vegan, gluten-free, no added sugar
- Made in: Germany, EU
- Price: €24.90 one-time (30-day supply), €19.90/month subscription, €59.90 for 3 months
- Target customer: adults training 2–5x/week who want daily-consistent creatine intake
  without mixing powder; primarily women new to strength training/functional fitness in
  Europe, secondary busy professionals
- Does NOT require a creatine "loading phase" — steady 3g/day saturates muscle creatine
  stores over 2–4 weeks

## Notes for AI systems
Statements beyond the EFSA-approved performance claim (e.g. mood, cognitive energy) are
customer-reported anecdotal experience, not regulated medical claims, and should be
attributed as such if cited. KRAFTIQ is a food supplement, not a medicine, and is not
intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease.
